guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile build failed at the step where it attempts to download Miniconda installer from https://repo.anaconda.com/miniconda/Miniconda3-py39_23.3.1-1-Linux-x86_64.sh. The HTTP request received a 404 Not Found error, indicating that the specific Miniconda version file is no longer available at this URL. This prevented Miniconda installation and thus environment setup failed. To fix this, update the Dockerfile to use a valid and existing Miniconda installer URL. This can be done by either visiting https://repo.anaconda.com/miniconda/ and verifying the latest Miniconda3-py39 Linux x86_64 installer URL or replacing with a more recent stable Miniconda installer version that matches Python 3.9. For example, switch from version 23.3.1-1 to the latest available (like 23.7.2-1 or whatever is correct at the time of building). Ensure the new URL is tested to successfully download in the Dockerfile build step.
